newsitem.title: UK: European VGO softer, low sulphur very tight.
newsitem.headline: European VGO softer, low sulphur very tight.

text.p: European vacuum gas oil was softer on Wednesday from last week's high levels in response to easier crude.
Low sulphur was seen to be very tight with cargoes almost non-existant and barges difficult to find.
Two barges of 5,000 tonnes were heard done at $147 fob NWE, destined for Germany.
The arbitrage to the U.S. is open and demand remains strong from short American buyers.

High sulphur VGO was not as tight as low sulphur and four Russian cargoes arriving at the end of the week or early next week are looking for customers. A 1.8 sulphur 25,000 tonne cargo becomes available in early September.
